r65.finding: summary-only edit 8080 -> 7970, without attached new raw execution; accept withdrawn; original bytes retained

artifactOnly.decision: rollback completion shortcut; metadata may describe storage only; no retrospective approval

independence.finding: same-actor verification cannot claim non-author acceptance; filenames and old reviewer strings alone are not identity evidence
independence.currentRun: Codex author self-check; no independent credit

r27.decoding: Trailing U+2420 -> U+0020 and U+21E5 -> U+0009 only; no blanket character replacement.

r24.finding: A hash was asserted without an authenticated matching blob/output; withdrawn. This run verifies the intended receipt hash, not an exhaustive SHA256 search of every repository blob.

r22.credit: chain completeness only; no newly certified independent verdict

r38.status: unused identifier; no R38 document batch was executed or accepted
r38.correction: Previously unexplained numbering gap; no inferred R38 review credit.

r66.finding: Eight task log lines appended after migration; they are not a command run or independent acceptance. Historical semantic accept withdrawn; fresh current commands are captured separately.

gateGap: Old gates checked headings, links and hashes, not generated prose readability. The damaged text was not a parsed Markdown link and did not alter original-source quotes. A real auditDocuments corruption check and regression now reject it.

receiptHistoryScreen.decision: Other candidates are a mechanical screen, not proof of fabricated execution; primary raw-run verification remains pending. This is not a clean audit declaration.
